subject: By-Election - Saint–Hyacinthe—Bagot—Acton
precis: Order directing that a writ of election do issue in order to fill the vacancy in the House of Commons for the electoral district of Saint–Hyacinthe—Bagot—Acton, in Quebec, with polling to take place on December 7, 2026.
